title: Zesty Silky Argentinian Beef Empanadas
description: A paleo-friendly Argentinian dish featuring tender beef and silky single cream, wrapped in a flaky pastry crust. This recipe is a romantic twist on traditional empanadas.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the single cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture cook until the cream has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
Roll out the paleo pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Use a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out circles of dough.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg and fold the dough in half to form a half moon shape.
Press the edges of the dough together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
